raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions contains 28 txn_ids delivered twice, once as record_version 1 and once as record_version 2 with a corrected amount, and silver_transactions keeps both copies. The fix is to keep only the latest record_version per txn_id before applying the POSTED filter, so a superseded POSTED copy cannot survive when the newer version is REVERSED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
